scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @commondays/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @commondays/web" "npm run dev --workspace @commondays/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @commondays/shared && npm run dev --workspace @commondays/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @commondays/shared && npm run dev --workspace @commondays/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace @commondays/shared && npm run build --workspace @commondays/api
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build --workspace @commondays/web
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @commondays/shared && npm run check --workspace @commondays/api && npm run check --workspace @commondays/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @commondays/shared && npm run test --workspace @commondays/api && npm run test --workspace @commondays/web
